page-parsed.eventDescription: One successfully parsed search page: $5 per 1,000 pages. Billed even when filters, duplicates or monitoring leave zero rows. Failed requests and unrecognized pages are not charged. Separate delivered-row fee applies. No start fee; proxy and compute included. maxTotalChargeUsd is an Apify run option; before another page the budget must cover a page plus one row.

job.eventDescription: One delivered job: $1 per 1,000 rows. Row keys: id, job_id, title, url, company, company_url, location, posted_date, posted_text, salary_text, logo_url, description. Filtered, duplicate, unchanged or excluded rows have no row fee. Parsed pages cost $0.005 each, even with no delivered rows. No start fee; proxy and compute included. Stops at the maxTotalChargeUsd run-option budget. With includeDetails=true this event is replaced by job-with-description, not added to it.

job-with-description.eventDescription: One delivered job with a successfully fetched full description: $4 per 1,000 enriched jobs. Replaces the $0.001 job event, not an add-on. Row keys include description, seniority, employment_type, job_function and industries; unavailable criteria stay null. Failed descriptions have no job fee. Parsed search pages cost $0.005 each, including filtered or unchanged checks. No start fee; proxy and compute included. maxTotalChargeUsd is a run option, not input.
